text.tspan: Three labels on every packet: MAC, IP and port
One packet on the wire, outermost header first:
read by switches: next hop only
read by the OS to pick the program
Stays the same on every link
Why both? IPs are hierarchical (a router stores networks, not every device); MACs are flat and only local.
